# Diga

> Diga is a no-code platform for building AI voice agents that answer and make phone calls. It bundles telephony, workflow automations and knowledge bases in one product, and exposes everything through a REST API and a hosted MCP server. Built by Diga agentes SL (Spain). Website: https://www.diga.io. Dashboard: https://dashboard.diga.io.

Documentation is available in Spanish (default) and English. Every page listed below is also served as Markdown at the linked `.md` URL.

## When to use Diga

Reach for Diga when a user asks you to automate a job that happens over a phone call:

- **Answer inbound calls**: a receptionist or support line that answers questions from a knowledge base (text, URLs or files) and transfers or ends the call.
- **Book, reschedule or cancel appointments by phone**: ready-made templates connect to Google Calendar and Cal.com.
- **Call leads and qualify them**: outbound agents that call form leads, qualify interest and book a meeting, with a HubSpot template.
- **Outbound sales and follow-up calls**: cold-call prospects, then log results (for example to Google Sheets) or send a follow-up (for example over WhatsApp) with post-call workflows.
- **Run logic before, during or after a call**: pre-call workflows personalise or block a call, during-call workflows act as agent tools, post-call workflows update CRMs and notify teams.
- **Give phone numbers to an agent**: buy numbers in Diga or bring your own through a SIP trunk (Twilio, Netelip or custom).
- **Inspect what happened on a call**: list calls and read transcripts, recordings, logs and traces.

Diga is not the right tool when the user needs no phone call at all, or only wants raw speech-to-text or text-to-speech with no call handling.

## How an agent should call Diga

1. **Get a project API key.** A project admin creates it in the dashboard under Settings > Project > API Keys. Ask the user for a key restricted to the resources the task needs (each resource can be set to no access, read or write). A key belongs to exactly one project.
2. **Pick an interface.**
   - MCP (preferred for AI assistants): Streamable HTTP server at `https://mcp.diga.io/mcp`, server name `diga`, authenticated with the header `x-api-key: <DIGA_API_KEY>` or `Authorization: Bearer <DIGA_API_KEY>`. Tools map to API operations.
   - REST API: base URL `https://api.diga.io`, versioned under `/v1`, authenticated with `Authorization: Bearer <DIGA_API_KEY>`. OpenAPI spec: https://api.diga.io/openapi.json (also mirrored at https://docs.diga.io/api-reference/openapi.json).
3. **Start read-only.** List agents or calls first to confirm the key and the project.
4. **Confirm side effects with the user.** Creating calls consumes plan minutes and dials real phone numbers; buying phone numbers costs money; deleting agents, calls or knowledge bases is permanent.

Key pages: [MCP server](https://docs.diga.io/en/mcp/mcp-server.md) · [API keys and permissions](https://docs.diga.io/en/platform/api-keys.md) · [Create your first agent](https://docs.diga.io/en/create-agent.md) · [Plans and pricing](https://docs.diga.io/en/platform/billing.md)

- [Flujos Durante Llamada](https://docs.diga.io/es/build/flujos/flujos-durante-llamada.md): Permite que tu agente ejecute un flujo multi-paso en mitad de la conversación, como una herramienta

##### Agentes

- [Gestión de citas (Google Calendar)](https://docs.diga.io/es/plantillas/agentes/gestion-citas-google-calendar.md): Recepcionista telefónica que consulta tu agenda y deja la cita creada en Google Calendar
- [Gestión de leads (HubSpot)](https://docs.diga.io/es/plantillas/agentes/gestion-leads.md): Agente que llama a los leads que rellenan tu formulario y les agenda una cita con el equipo
- [Gestión de citas (Cal.com)](https://docs.diga.io/es/plantillas/agentes/gestion-citas-calcom.md): Agente que agenda, reprograma y cancela citas por voz usando Cal.com
- [Ventas outbound](https://docs.diga.io/es/plantillas/agentes/ventas-outbound.md): Agente que llama en frío a prospectos, califica su interés y agenda una demo con ventas

##### Flujos

- [Comprobar disponibilidad (Google Calendar)](https://docs.diga.io/es/plantillas/flujos/comprobar-disponibilidad.md): Flujo durante llamada que devuelve los huecos libres de tu Google Calendar
- [Crear cita (Google Calendar)](https://docs.diga.io/es/plantillas/flujos/crear-cita.md): Flujo durante llamada que comprueba el hueco y crea el evento en tu Google Calendar
- [Disparador de llamada mediante Webhook](https://docs.diga.io/es/plantillas/flujos/llamada-saliente-formulario.md): Flujo lanzador de llamadas que toma el teléfono del lead y llama un minuto después de recibir el formulario
- [Gestión de lead postllamada (HubSpot)](https://docs.diga.io/es/plantillas/flujos/gestion-leads-hubspot.md): Flujo post-llamada que clasifica el resultado, actualiza el contacto en HubSpot y envía el email correspondiente
- [Obtener tipos de cita (Cal.com)](https://docs.diga.io/es/plantillas/flujos/obtener-eventos-calcom.md): Flujo pre-llamada que trae los tipos de cita disponibles en Cal.com antes de que el agente hable
- [Comprobar disponibilidad (Cal.com)](https://docs.diga.io/es/plantillas/flujos/comprobar-disponibilidad-calcom.md): Flujo durante llamada que devuelve los huecos libres de un tipo de cita en Cal.com
- [Crear cita (Cal.com)](https://docs.diga.io/es/plantillas/flujos/crear-cita-calcom.md): Flujo durante llamada que crea la reserva en Cal.com
- [Buscar cita (Cal.com)](https://docs.diga.io/es/plantillas/flujos/buscar-cita-calcom.md): Flujo durante llamada que localiza las citas futuras de un cliente en Cal.com por su email
- [Reprogramar cita (Cal.com)](https://docs.diga.io/es/plantillas/flujos/reprogramar-cita-calcom.md): Flujo durante llamada que mueve una reserva existente a un nuevo hueco en Cal.com
- [Cancelar cita (Cal.com)](https://docs.diga.io/es/plantillas/flujos/cancelar-cita-calcom.md): Flujo durante llamada que anula una reserva existente en Cal.com
- [Guardar resultado de llamada (Google Sheets)](https://docs.diga.io/es/plantillas/flujos/guardar-resultado-llamada-sheets.md): Flujo post-llamada que extrae con IA el resultado de una llamada de ventas y lo guarda en Google Sheets
- [Enviar información (WhatsApp)](https://docs.diga.io/es/plantillas/flujos/enviar-informacion-whatsapp.md): Flujo post-llamada que manda por WhatsApp un enlace de recursos un minuto después de colgar

#### Catalog

##### Agents

##### Flows

- [Check availability (Google Calendar)](https://docs.diga.io/en/templates/flows/check-availability.md): During-call workflow that returns the free slots in your Google Calendar
- [Create appointment (Google Calendar)](https://docs.diga.io/en/templates/flows/create-appointment.md): During-call workflow that checks the slot and creates the event in your Google Calendar
- [Outbound call trigger (Webhook)](https://docs.diga.io/en/templates/flows/outbound-call-form-trigger.md): Call-launching workflow that takes the lead's phone number and calls one minute after the form arrives
- [Post-call lead management (HubSpot)](https://docs.diga.io/en/templates/flows/post-call-lead-management-hubspot.md): Post-call workflow that classifies the outcome, updates the contact in HubSpot, and sends the matching email
- [Get event types (Cal.com)](https://docs.diga.io/en/templates/flows/get-event-types-cal-com.md): Pre-call workflow that fetches the available appointment types from Cal.com before the agent speaks
- [Check availability (Cal.com)](https://docs.diga.io/en/templates/flows/check-availability-cal-com.md): During-call workflow that returns the free slots for an appointment type in Cal.com
- [Create appointment (Cal.com)](https://docs.diga.io/en/templates/flows/create-appointment-cal-com.md): During-call workflow that books the appointment in Cal.com
- [Find appointment (Cal.com)](https://docs.diga.io/en/templates/flows/find-appointment-cal-com.md): During-call workflow that looks up a customer's upcoming Cal.com appointments by email
- [Reschedule appointment (Cal.com)](https://docs.diga.io/en/templates/flows/reschedule-appointment-cal-com.md): During-call workflow that moves an existing Cal.com booking to a new slot
- [Cancel appointment (Cal.com)](https://docs.diga.io/en/templates/flows/cancel-appointment-cal-com.md): During-call workflow that cancels an existing Cal.com booking
- [Save call result (Google Sheets)](https://docs.diga.io/en/templates/flows/save-call-result-sheets.md): Post-call workflow that uses AI to extract a sales call's outcome and saves it to Google Sheets
- [Send follow-up (WhatsApp)](https://docs.diga.io/en/templates/flows/send-follow-up-whatsapp.md): Post-call workflow that sends a resource link over WhatsApp one minute after the call ends
